question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

The librarian encouraged __**meticulous**__ organisation of the books on the shelves.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sloppy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail, being very careful and precise in approach. (सावधानीपूर्वक)

 
 
• **Example:** She is meticulous in her preparations for the meeting, ensuring everything is perfect.
 
 
 
• **"Sloppy"** refers to being careless, untidy, or lacking attention to detail. It is the antonym of "meticulous." (असावधान या अस्त-व्यस्त)
 
 
• **Example:** His sloppy handwriting made it difficult to read the notes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'meticulous'** is **'sloppy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sloppy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Detailed** (विस्तृत): Including many small elements or features; thorough.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave a detailed description of the incident during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Orderly** (सुसंगत ): Arranged or organized in a systematic manner.
 
 
• **Example: **The orderly arrangement of files made it easier to find the required document.
 
 
 
• **Categorised** (वर्गीकृत): Sorted or classified into specific groups or categories.
 
 
• **Example:** The books were categorised according to their genres in the library.
